identity.notes: Official Bethesda Bagels surfaces and the restaurant-linked Toast Wildwood page identify the same Bethesda location; other Bethesda Bagels locations were excluded.

sources.excerpt: Official Bethesda Bagels site identifies the brand and links its menu and online ordering surfaces.
Official Bagels & Spreads page lists current bagel, spread, and plant-based menu presentations; it is brand-wide and does not isolate Wildwood inventory.
Official Breakfast page lists breakfast sandwich presentations and links online ordering; location-specific availability is delegated to ordering.

Restaurant-linked Toast ordering surface identifies Bethesda Bagels Wildwood at 10241 Old Georgetown Rd, Bethesda, MD and exposes sandwiches, drinks, soups/pickles/hash browns, online items, cold items to go, custom people, salads, and contribution sections.
Indexed Toast item page confirms the Wildwood location and current category headings/items including breakfast, lunchtime goodies, drinks, soups, cold items, and online items.
Official catering PDF is a supporting menu document with dated/operational catering presentations; it is not a current Wildwood item-level allergen matrix.
Targeted search surfaced official menu and catering material but no current official item-level allergen matrix for Wildwood.
